correctness.rationale: The standard finite-rank reproducing-kernel identity is proved from the evaluation resolvent. Root-of-unity projection yields the exact central rational kernel. Its scalar equation has exactly two distinct positive roots, one inside and one beyond y=1; the smaller crosses the physical |z|=1 boundary at the explicit positive mass. Monotonicity, simplicity, all q roots and both asymptotics are proved analytically. Symbolic and direct Gram checks corroborate without replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The main natural zero invariant is completely classified for every positive point-mass parameter, radius and polygon order. It has an exact strength phase transition, q simultaneous simple roots for unbounded q, convergence to the atoms, universal near-boundary cost and exponential high-order cost, and explicitly breaks a radial central-fiber no-zero obstruction. This is a motivated classification rather than an arbitrary table or restatement of the rank-one formula.
